import pathlib,json,subprocess,hashlib,os,time,shutil,re,ctypes
repo=pathlib.Path('C:/Users/Dan/Desktop/Projects/formal-pvnp');pkg=repo/'certifications/realizable-hardness';ev=repo/'research/p-equals-np'
out=pkg/'.lake/build/covering-tv-independent-review-20260912';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
hash=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
receipts=[json.loads((ev/f'2026-09-12-realizable-hardness-{n}-proof-verification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for n in ['companion','geometry','density','tail-exception','flag']]
d=receipts[-1];copies=[]
for e in [e for r in receipts for e in r['exports'] if e['module']!='PvNP']:
 rel=pathlib.Path(*e['module'].split('.')).with_suffix('.olean');src=pkg/'.lake/build/flag-independent-review-20260912/lib/lean'/rel
 assert hash(src.read_bytes())==e['output_sha256'];dst=out/'lib/lean'/rel;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(src,dst);assert hash(dst.read_bytes())==e['output_sha256'];copies.append({'module':e['module'],'source':str(src),'output':str(dst),'sha256':e['output_sha256']})
assert len(copies)==49
env=os.environ.copy();parts=d['environment']['LEAN_PATH'].split(';');parts=[p for p in parts if '/.lake/packages/' in p.replace('\\','/') or '/.elan/toolchains/' in p.replace('\\','/')];env['LEAN_PATH']=';'.join([str(out/'lib/lean')]+parts);env['LEAN_NUM_THREADS']='1';env['PYTHONUTF8']='1';env['PYTHONIOENCODING']='utf-8'
version=subprocess.check_output(['lean','--version'],cwd=pkg,env=env,text=True).strip();assert version==d['environment']['toolchain'];assert hash((pkg/'lake-manifest.json').read_bytes())==d['manifest_sha256']
manifest=json.loads((pkg/'lake-manifest.json').read_text());heads=[]
for p in manifest['packages']:
 head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=pkg/'.lake/packages'/p['name'],text=True).strip();assert head==p['rev'];heads.append({'name':p['name'],'revision':head})
class Memory(ctypes.Structure):
 _fields_=[('length',ctypes.c_ulong),('load',ctypes.c_ulong)]+[(n,ctypes.c_ulonglong) for n in ['totalPhys','availPhys','totalPage','availPage','totalVirtual','availVirtual','availExtended']]
def available():
 m=Memory();m.length=ctypes.sizeof(m);assert ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(m));return m.availPhys
candidate='d32d0c9cc1f264c8e4a90137d517270b3162afa9'
r={'candidate_commit':candidate,'environment':{'LEAN_PATH':env['LEAN_PATH'],'LEAN_NUM_THREADS':'1','toolchain':version,'PYTHONUTF8':'1','PYTHONIOENCODING':'utf-8'},'accepted_dependency_copies':copies,'manifest_sha256':d['manifest_sha256'],'dependency_pins':heads,'exports':[],'runner_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
for name in ['CoveringTV','CoveringTVChecks']:
 source=pkg/'lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness'/f'{name}.lean';raw=source.read_bytes();frozen=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',candidate+':'+source.relative_to(repo).as_posix()],cwd=repo);assert raw==frozen
 assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide|axiom)\b',re.sub(r'/\-.*?\-/|--[^\n]*','',raw.decode('utf-8'),flags=re.S))
 dest=out/'lib/lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness'/f'{name}.olean';log=out/f'{name}-{time.time_ns()}.log';cmd=['lean','-R','lean','-o',str(dest),str(source)];mem=available();assert mem>=768*1024**2;assert shutil.disk_usage('C:/').free>=768*1024**2
 print('START',name,'memory',mem,flush=True)
 with log.open('wb') as f:
  p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=pkg,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT);print('PID',p.pid,flush=True)
  while True:
   try:code=p.wait(timeout=10);break
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    if available()<640*1024**2 or shutil.disk_usage('C:/').free<640*1024**2:subprocess.run(['taskkill','/PID',str(p.pid),'/T','/F']);code=p.wait();break
 meta={'command':cmd,'exit_code':code,'available_memory_before':mem};(out/(log.stem+'.exit.json')).write_text(json.dumps(meta),encoding='utf-8');data=log.read_bytes();s=data.decode('utf-8');profiles=re.findall(r"'([^']+)' (depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)",s);queries=re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)',raw.decode('utf-8'),re.M)
 row={'module':'PvNP.RealizableHardness.'+name,'source':str(source),'source_sha256':hash(raw),'candidate_match':True,**meta,'log':str(log),'log_sha256':hash(data),'raw_log_utf8':s,'output':str(dest),'output_sha256':hash(dest.read_bytes()) if dest.exists() else None,'query_order':queries,'axiom_profiles':profiles,'examples':len(re.findall(r'^example\b',raw.decode('utf-8'),re.M))};r['exports'].append(row);(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print('END',name,code,'profiles',len(profiles),flush=True)
 assert code==0 and len(profiles)==len(queries) and 'sorryAx' not in s
 for q,pf in zip(queries,profiles):assert pf[0].endswith('.'+q) and set(x.strip() for x in pf[2].split(',') if x.strip())<={'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}
assert sum(len(e['axiom_profiles']) for e in r['exports'])==20;assert sum(e['examples'] for e in r['exports'])==7
print('ALL2 EXIT0; 20 profiles; 7 examples',flush=True)
